day.title: Define the year one outcome
day.objective: Complete define the year one outcome and produce mission_acceptance.md with traceable evidence.
inputs: R0.1 one-page mission, engineering baseline and Decisions tab.
steps: Open the required inputs listed below. Check the exact revision and identify unresolved decisions for 'define the year one outcome'. Do not assume equipment, approval or test results exist.
Read the mission PDF and write the six demonstrations you intend to show: companion, records, medication log, communication, two three-step trials and supported handling.
Copy the exclusions into your mission: fictional data only, no diagnosis, no person support, no cargo walking and no unsupervised high-energy motion.
Perform this completion check and save the actual observations: Compare every sentence with JB-R-001 to 009 and 057 to 064; remove any extra clinical or physical promise.

Save the deliverable as JacobsBaymax/requirements/day_001_mission_acceptance.md. Include revision R0.2, actual date, accountable owner Faisal Farouq, your actual role, source references, results and unresolved limitations. Preserve prior evidence.

Record PASS, REWORK or BLOCKED for this day with the actual evidence reference and time spent. PASS means the stated task was evidenced; it does not release a gate, certify safety or prove the whole robot works.
acceptance: Compare every sentence with JB-R-001 to 009 and 057 to 064; remove any extra clinical or physical promise.
